items.title: Harry Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: most notably Sonny Rollins... I like Sonny Rollins because he had such a wonderful sound

ctx.x: Why do they all sound the same?

Because they all have grown up listening to — I mean this is of course an over- generalization — but most young players have grown up listening to John Coltrane and emulating him. Imagine if of the big three of Coleman Hawkins and Ben Webster and Lester Young, imagine if there was only one, and everybody was a disciple of one rather — then everybody would come out sounding a lot more alike. But people pick different heroes. Well today it’s mostly John Coltrane. So you have a lot of people that sound like…
